subject: info-trns
title: (R)INFO.TRNS.----- PHY.U.P.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-27 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two), first of two on book p171. Opens Braxton's culture-procedure analysis: 'the significance of world culture must be understood with respect to what progressional continuance implies about procedure.' (R)INFO-TRNS (the reality of information transference) is crossed with PHY-U-P (physical universe particulars): the question is what information-transference produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with physical-universe-particulars — the (R) prefix marking that real information-transference is what differentiates real procedure from spectacle-procedure. TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics) sits at the upper-center. TRS (transition) branches from the main line and carries TH-CONT-DY and ALT-F (alternative functionalism); SOC-RT (social reality) branches from ALT-F. PHY-U-P is the partner. (R)INT (the reality of intention) sits below the central axis. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) also branches from the main line and carries PR-TRS and WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle); ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) branches from WO-EXP-PRI.
